text: {"question":"What percentage of stars within the JAGB color-magnitude selection box in the Milky Way were found to be oxygen-rich according to the spectroscopic survey described?","reference_answer":"The spectroscopic survey found that 76 ± 6 % of the stars in the JAGB selection box were oxygen‑rich.","passage_1_contribution":"Passage A reports a 76 ± 6 % oxygen‑rich contamination in the JAGB selection box.","passage_2_contribution":"Passage B confirms the 76 ± 6 % contamination and notes it remains high (71 %) near the JAGB peak.","joint_reason":"Both passages provide the same contamination percentage, with Passage B offering a confirmation and additional detail.","same_quantity":true}
